checks.assertion: - Neutral cross-runtime cases cover DST/day boundaries, monthly gaps, positive/negative events, duplicate completions, pauses/skips/corrections, history gaps and paging. Component checks verify unknown and lower-bound labels plus normal-theme chart readability.
criteria: Daily/Habit statistics match the explicit schedule/day rules and distinguish verified, lower-bound and unavailable results.
Missing history, current-day grace or negative-only activity cannot produce fabricated complete-history or lifetime streak claims.
